Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played?

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card is played. In what order do they activate?

Card Q&A.a: You can activate the 2nd [All Turns] effect first.  When [Kotenken] was played, this card's 1st [All Turns] effect triggered, but a rule check occurs before activation, and [Kotenken] becomes a target for deletion. The 2nd [All Turns] effect triggers immediately before this deletion, and you can interrupt and activate it.  In addition, if a Digimon with 10000 DP or less was played by this effect, a rule check will occur again and that Digimon will be deleted.  Once all of the rule checks are resolved, you then can activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect.
Card Q&A.q: All of my Digimon get -10000 DP. I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to play [Kotenken].  At such times, [Kotenken]'s DP will become 0 and it will be deleted. In what order can I activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect and 2nd [All Turns] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it's deleted.  Even if it's deleted, you can activate this card's 1st [All Turns] effect.
Card Q&A.q: All of my Digimon get -5000 DP. I used this card's [All Turns] effect to play a Digimon with 5000 DP or less.  At such times, is the played Digimon deleted before the 1st [All Turns] effect activates?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Kotenken] Token. (Digimon/Black/9000 DP/＜Blocker＞)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played, return 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the bottom of the deck.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [SW] trait card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
